approach: Test-only. Pin the Postgres session timezone to UTC for the test suite via PGTZ in phpunit.xml, and add a regression test that fails loudly on any machine whose Postgres session is not UTC. No production-reaching file is touched.

subtasks.title: Pin the test suite's Postgres session timezone to UTC + regression test
subtasks.approach: TDD. (1) Write tests/Feature/Database/PostgresConnectionTimezoneTest.php asserting (a) every pgsql connection's session TimeZone is UTC and (b) a naive Carbon round-trips through a timestamptz column with zero delta. Confirm RED on this box (session is America/Chicago). (2) Add <env name="PGTZ" value="UTC" force="true"/> to phpunit.xml's <php> block. Confirm GREEN. (3) Re-run the two originally-failing files to confirm all three assertions pass.
subtasks.intended_diffs: phpunit.xml: one <env> line inside the existing <php> block, alongside the other force="true" entries. New test file: a Feature test extending Tests\TestCase with two test methods and no fixtures beyond a session-local TEMP table.

excluded_sites.site: config/database.php ('timezone' => 'UTC' on the five pgsql connections)
excluded_sites.reason: Rejected by the operator, twice and on two distinct variants. (1) At the Phase 2 gate, the hardcoded 'timezone' => 'UTC' - config/database.php ships to production. (2) After review finding M1, the env-driven 'timezone' => env('DB_TIMEZONE') variant, which the driver verified is a byte-identical production no-op when DB_TIMEZONE is unset (PostgresConnector::configureTimezone guards on isset(), and null is not isset). The operator chose the smallest diff that touches nothing outside the test suite. KNOWN LIMITATION, accepted knowingly: on a non-UTC host every process other than PHPUnit - bootstrap seeding, Herd web requests, hand-run artisan commands, the QA seeder - still writes shifted timestamptz values.
No defect. All ->utc() calls are ->copy()->utc(); all Carbon::parse calls pass explicit 'UTC'. Confirmed independently by three blind prep passes.
No defect. diffInMinutes calls already abs()-guarded since commit 37d48434a7.
The ticket's stated hypothesis. Falsified - never referenced from either failing code path.
